about: Sam's Shoe Service is at 1110 E 24th St in Bryan.

It repairs shoes, boots, purses and luggage. In June 2026, KBTX reported that State Rep. Paul Dyson honored the shop with a Texas Treasure Business Award. One reviewer had worn-out cowboy boots resoled and polished with a quick turnaround.
Customers have given it 4.8 stars across 34 Google reviews.
